<!--
  A footer with more than links. Axes: layout (stats: the brand with three figures and a sitemap link over the
  link groups as cards; points, links, newsletter, contacts, channels: a split beside a picture with the brand
  and four points, the brand and small link columns, a newsletter card and link columns, the contacts and two
  actions, or the community channels and figures), mediaSide, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { FooterExtras, FooterSplitLabels } from "./footer-split.types";
import type { MegaGroup } from "./mega-menu.types";
import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";
import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

export type FooterSplitProps = {
  id?: string;
  label: string;
  brand: string;
  tagline: string;
  copyright: string;
  groups: MegaGroup[];
  extras: FooterExtras;
  labels: FooterSplitLabels;
  layout?: "stats" | "points" | "links" | "newsletter" | "contacts" | "channels";
  mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Container from "../primitives/container/container.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Link from "../primitives/link/link.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.vue";
import FooterBrand from "../components/footer-brand.vue";
import FooterChannels from "../components/footer-channels.vue";
import FooterContacts from "../components/footer-contacts.vue";
import FooterFigures from "../components/footer-figures.vue";
import FooterGroupCards from "../components/footer-group-cards.vue";
import FooterLinkColumns from "../components/footer-link-columns.vue";
import FooterPoints from "../components/footer-points.vue";
import FooterSignupCard from "../components/footer-signup-card.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id = "footer",
  label,
  brand,
  tagline,
  copyright,
  groups,
  extras,
  labels,
  layout = "stats",
  mediaSide = "end",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<FooterSplitProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="footer"
    :class="cn('border-t border-border', (((tone as string) === 'muted') ? 'bg-muted' : ''))"
    data-testid="footer-split"
    :data-layout="layout"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Container :class="cn('mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4', 'py-12')" data-slot="container">
      <Stack v-if="((layout as string) === 'stats')" gap="8" align="stretch">
        <Group gap="6" align="start" justify="between" class="flex-wrap">
          <Stack gap="6" align="start">
            <FooterBrand :brand="brand" :tagline="tagline" />
            <FooterFigures :extras="extras" />
          </Stack>
          <Link href="#/sitemap" size="sm" data-testid="footer-sitemap">
            <LucideIcon name="arrow-right" :size="16" />
            {{ labels.sitemap }}
          </Link>
        </Group>
        <FooterGroupCards :label="label" :groups="groups" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel" />
        <Box class="border-t border-border pt-6">
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ copyright }}
          </Text>
        </Box>
      </Stack>
      <Box v-else class="grid grid-cols-1 items-center gap-8 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <MediaFrame v-if="((mediaSide as string) === 'start')" :alt="brand" ratio="4/3" />
        <Stack gap="8" align="stretch">
          <FooterBrand
            v-if="(((layout as string) === 'points') || ((layout as string) === 'links'))"
            :brand="brand"
            :tagline="tagline"
          />
          <Stack v-else gap="2" align="start">
            <Text size="xl" weight="bold">
              {{ (((layout as string) === "newsletter") ? labels.loopTitle : (((layout as string) === "channels") ? labels.joinTitle : labels.title)) }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ (((layout as string) === "newsletter") ? labels.loopText : (((layout as string) === "channels") ? labels.joinText : labels.text)) }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <FooterPoints v-if="((layout as string) === 'points')" :extras="extras" :title="labels.points" />
          <FooterSignupCard v-if="((layout as string) === 'newsletter')" :id="id" :labels="labels" />
          <FooterLinkColumns
            v-if="(((layout as string) === 'links') || ((layout as string) === 'newsletter'))"
            :label="label"
            :groups="groups"
            :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
          />
          <template v-if="((layout as string) === 'contacts')">
            <FooterContacts :extras="extras" />
            <ActionGroup :primary="labels.cta" primaryHref="#/contact" :secondary="labels.secondary" secondaryHref="#/work" />
          </template>
          <template v-if="((layout as string) === 'channels')">
            <FooterChannels :extras="extras" />
            <FooterFigures :extras="extras" />
          </template>
          <Box class="border-t border-border pt-6">
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ copyright }}
            </Text>
          </Box>
        </Stack>
        <MediaFrame v-if="((mediaSide as string) !== 'start')" :alt="brand" ratio="4/3" />
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
